metadata.title: Global Agricultural Subsidies, Grants & Financial Incentive Database

programs.name: Bundesprogramm Energieeffizienz in Landwirtschaft und Gartenbau
programs.agency: Bundesanstalt für Landwirtschaft und Ernährung (BLE) / BMEL
targetEquipment: High-performance thermal climate screens (Energieschirme)
Industrial horticultural LED lighting fixtures
Multiple energy-saving glazing retrofits (Doppelstegplatten, Isolierglas)
Flue gas heat recovery condensers and buffer tanks
programs.eligibility: Commercial horticultural businesses with minimum 20% certified CO2/energy reduction confirmed by an accredited energy consultant (Energieberater).
programs.summary: Germany's flagship greenhouse modernization grant covering up to 40% of capital costs for thermal screens, LED conversion, and greenhouse insulation.

programs.name: Agrarinvestitionsförderungsprogramm (AFP) Nordrhein-Westfalen
targetEquipment: New modern greenhouse construction (Venlo glasshouses)
Closed-loop nutrient recirculation systems with UV/Ozone disinfection
Automated climate computers and irrigation controllers
Rainwater collection holding basins and pumping stations
programs.eligibility: Agricultural and horticultural enterprises meeting minimum economic viability criteria, holding vocational qualifications (e.g. Gärtnermeister or equivalent).
programs.deadline: Annual selection rounds (typically Spring and Autumn cut-offs)
programs.summary: Premier structural modernization program for NRW greenhouses in Straelen/Niederrhein supporting sustainable facility expansion.

programs.name: GAP Junglandwirte-Einkommensunterstützung & Niederlassungsprämie
programs.subsidyType: Direct Income Top-Up & Capital Settlement Grant
programs.subsidyRate: Fixed per ha + Up to €70,000 settlement bonus
programs.maxAmount: Up to €70,000 lump sum + €134/ha/year for 5 years
targetEquipment: Farm acquisition and initial operating capital
Digital farm steering technology and diagnostic sensors
First-time equipment purchase and establishment expenses
programs.eligibility: Head of agricultural business under 40 years of age established within the last 5 years with certified vocational qualification (Ausbildung / Meister).
programs.deadline: Annual single application window (Gemeinsamer Antrag, typically May 15)
programs.summary: Special young farmer establishment bonus providing direct cash injection for initial horticultural enterprise founders.

programs.name: USDA NRCS Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP)
targetEquipment: Commercial High Tunnels (season extension unheated structures)
Micro-irrigation and precision drip fertigation systems
Nutrient management monitoring sensors and soil moisture probes
Water conservation recycling reservoirs
programs.eligibility: Agricultural producers in compliance with highly erodible land and wetland conservation provisions with adjusted gross income (AGI) < $900,000.
programs.deadline: Continuous batching with state-specific ranking dates
programs.summary: Federal cost-share covering up to 75-90% of high tunnel construction and micro-irrigation systems across all 50 US states.

programs.name: USDA Rural Energy for America Program (REAP) Grants
targetEquipment: Greenhouse rooftop & ground solar PV arrays
Commercial ground-source / air-source heat pumps
High-efficiency LED fixtures replacing HPS/HID lights
Automated dual thermal climate screens and thermal insulation
programs.eligibility: Agricultural producers deriving at least 50% of gross income from farming, located in rural or eligible agricultural areas.
programs.deadline: Quarterly application windows (March 31, June 30, September 30, December 31)
programs.summary: Massive federal clean energy grant funding 50% of the cost to install solar, heat pumps, and LED fixtures in agricultural facilities.

programs.name: 스마트팜 ICT 융복합 확산사업 (Smart Farm ICT Convergence)
targetEquipment: 온실 내외부 기상센서 (온습도, 일사량, CO2, 풍향풍속)
복합환경제어기 (Complex Climate Computer)
자동 양액공급기 및 배액 수질 계측기
원격 모바일 제어 CCTV 및 천측창 전동 구동기
programs.eligibility: 시설원예(채소·화훼) 재배 농업인 또는 농업법인으로 농업경영체 등록 완료 농가.
programs.deadline: 매년 1~2월 정기 접수 및 하반기 잔여예산 추가 모집
programs.summary: 한국 농식품부의 대표 스마트팜 사업으로 환경제어기, 센서, 양액기 등 ICT 설비비의 50~70%를 정부와 지자체가 직접 지원.

programs.name: 농업에너지이용효율화사업 (Agri-Energy Efficiency Improvement)
targetEquipment: 다겹보온커튼 및 알루미늄 스크린 개폐장치
지열 히트펌프 및 공기열 히트펌프 냉난방 설비
폐열회수 환기장치 및 배기열 회수기
배관 단열 및 온실 측벽 다중 피복재
programs.eligibility: 난방 시설을 갖춘 채소·화훼 온실 재배 농가로 에너지 20% 이상 절감 계획서 제출 농가.
programs.deadline: 매년 7~9월 익년도 사업 사전 신청 접수
programs.summary: 온실 다겹보온커튼과 히트펌프 설치비의 50%를 무상 지원하여 겨울철 시설원예 난방비를 40~60% 이상 감축시키는 지원사업.

programs.name: 청년후계농 영농정착지원사업 (Youth Farmer Settlement)
programs.subsidyType: Monthly Living Allowance Voucher & Low-Interest Loan
programs.subsidyRate: 월 최대 110만 원 바우처 + 5억 원 융자 (금리 1.5%)
targetEquipment: 온실 신축 부지 매입 및 농지 임대차
스마트팜 온실 시설물 시공 및 자재 구입
초기 종자, 비료, 양액 원자재 및 농기계 구입
programs.eligibility: 만 18세 이상 ~ 만 40세 미만 독립경영 3년 이하(예정자 포함) 청년 농업인.
programs.summary: 청년 스마트팜 창업을 위한 국가 지원으로 3년간 최대 3,600만 원 정착금과 연 1.5% 고정금리 5억 원 정책대출 제공.

programs.name: EG Subsidie: Energie-efficiëntie en hernieuwbare energie glastuinbouw
targetEquipment: Second high-grade thermal screen (Tweede energiescherm)
Diffuse glass retrofits with double anti-reflective coating
Low-temperature heat network distribution pipes
Air handling units with latent heat recovery
programs.eligibility: Commercial glasshouse horticultural companies operating in the Netherlands reducing natural gas consumption.
programs.deadline: Annual tender window (typically April to November)
programs.summary: Dutch national program supporting Venlo glasshouse growers in cutting gas dependency via dual thermal screens and diffuse glass.

programs.name: SDE++ (Stimulering Duurzame Energieproductie en Klimaattransitie)
programs.subsidyRate: Covers the non-profitable tariff gap per ton CO2 avoided
programs.maxAmount: Multi-million Euro subsidy commitment over 15 years
targetEquipment: Deep geothermal heating clusters for greenhouses (Aardwarmte)
Aquifer Thermal Energy Storage (ATES) systems
Megawatt-scale industrial electric heat pumps
Biomass heat & power with biogenic CO2 capture
programs.eligibility: Commercial greenhouse consortia, individual horticultural complexes, and heat grid operators.
programs.deadline: Annual phased bidding rounds (September to October)
programs.summary: The Netherlands' flagship 15-year operational subsidy funding deep geothermal and massive industrial heat pumps for glasshouses.

programs.name: Agricultural Clean Technology (ACT) Program - Adoption Stream
programs.subsidyRate: Up to 50% (Up to 60% for young/underrepresented farmers)
targetEquipment: High-efficiency greenhouse condensing heating boilers
LED conversion replacing high-pressure sodium fixtures
Automated thermal shade screens and envelope upgrades
Precision energy-management sensor networks
programs.eligibility: Canadian agricultural producers and greenhouse operators with projects directly reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
programs.deadline: Continuous intake until funding allocations are exhausted
programs.summary: Canadian federal grant funding up to 50-60% of greenhouse energy-efficient equipment retrofits and clean technology adoption.

programs.name: スマート農業推進総合対策事業 (Smart Agriculture Comprehensive Program)
programs.maxAmount: 사업 규모에 따른 정률 지원 (수천만 엔 단위)
targetEquipment: 시설원예 복합환경제어 장치 (온도, 습도, CO2, 차광 자동제어)
수경재배 양액 정밀 계측 및 자동 배합기
온실 생육 모니터링 카메라 및 환경 데이터 로거
자동 수확 및 운반 보조 로봇
programs.eligibility: 일본 내 인정농업인, 영농집단, 스마트농업 실증 컨소시엄 참여 농가.
programs.summary: 일본 농림수산성의 스마트농업 보급 대표 사업으로 첨단 복합환경제어기 및 센서 도입비 50%를 국가가 직접 보조.
